answer_prose: A next-race improvement of more than 2% occurred in 46.0% of pairs after a finishing section more than 5% faster than the preceding section, versus 36.2% after a similar or slower finish. This does not prove unused capacity in the earlier race.
detail_prose: The comparison conditions on returning for another recorded race, and the next race may have a different course and conditions.
